**ClassifyAutomatic tests alone cannot sign off the workflow.** The returned source now connects whole-file count production and persistence to classification, metadata JSON, client policy, editor saving and stale-response handling. This administrative synthesis does not establish application runtime behavior or a fresh task win.

Citation aliases identify these exact source files:

- P: `Site/App_Code/visualisering/code/FileLayerZoomPolicy.vb`
- S: `Site/App_Code/visualisering/code/FileLayerSpatialService.vb`
- C: `Site/modules/dashboard/ts/map/vsMap/vsFileLayerLazyLoaded.ts`
- E: `Site/modules/dashboard/ts/map/vsMap/mapLayer.ts`
- M: `Site/modules/dashboard/ts/map/vsMap/vsMap.ts`
- A: `Site/App_Code/visualisering/api-json/api-visualisering-kml.vb`
- K: `Site/App_Code/visualisering/code/visualisering-kml-filer.vb`
- H: `Site/kmlquery.aspx.vb`

The actual classifier is `_vs.FileLayerZoomPolicy.ClassifyAutomatic(Long,Long)`. In order, inclusive **BOTH-count** maxima are **(100,2500)→10; (500,10000)→12; (1000,25000)→14; (2000,50000)→15**; otherwise17. The first fitting band wins. It does not validate nonnegative inputs. `Resolve` classifies only when both counts exist; an override wins independently, and pending means effective zoom absent. [P:44–106]

One fresh stats object flows through `WriteFeatures → WriteAllDocuments`, reading the GeoJSON file or every converted row. Document parsing streams the feature array into `WriteFeature` with those shared stats. Empty geometry contributes nothing; valid stored features increment totals only after successful storage. Coordinate counting recursively sums child point counts. `BuildCache` verifies the stored feature count, then passes the same stats to `WriteMeta`, which writes both totals and reports write failures. [S:944–985,1069–1141,1185–1194,1269–1307,1425–1465,1965–2021]

`ReadMeta` requires the correct format and explicit nonnegative Int64 counts: missing, malformed, negative or overflowing values invalidate metadata; zero is valid. [S:2497–2568] `QueryCacheCore` calls `ReadMeta` and then separately `ResolvePolicy`, which supplies these whole-file counts to `Resolve`. Geometry collection follows; its separate viewport counters cannot substitute for classification inputs. [S:2257–2286,2343–2345,2372–2373]

The representative **metadata** path is direct: `QueryCacheCore → BuildMetaOnlyJson → AppendJson`; returned Ready JSON includes policy and source counts. `GetFileLayerViewport → QueryViewport` writes the result as UTF-8 `application/json`. Client metadata discovery parses JSON, applies policy and reevaluates geometry eligibility; `_readPolicy` derives effective/pending from override and Automatic. [S:2262–2273,2584–2608; P:382–393; H:195–249; C:324–375,237–247]

The map attaches the editor to a `vsFileLayerLazyLoaded` instance with edit permission. Its Save click calls `_saveZoomOverride → layer.setZoomOverride`, which sends `vskSetZoomOverride`. The endpoint persists through `UpdateZoomOverride` and serializes a lightweight descriptor into the ACK; client handling merges it and calls the editor callback. [M:1423–1427; E:470–473,594–596,827–873; C:1490–1511; A:393–400] These are source-level calls and matching fields, not proof of deployed routing or served assets.

| Concrete setup | Expected result |
|---|---|

| Resolve Automatic with neither count or either count missing; then override0/17 with missing counts | Automatic/effective absent and pendingtrue for Automatic; manual effective0/17, automatic absent, pendingfalse. Override0 with `(2001,50001)` keeps automatic17 but effective0. [P:53–106] |
| Two converted documents contain60 and41 valid single-point features, plus empty geometry; query a viewport seeing one feature | Shared prepared totals are101 features/101 coordinates, persisted as counts; Automatic12 remains independent of the one-feature viewport. Empty geometry adds nothing; validation/storage or metadata-write failures propagate. [S:971–985,1090–1126,1293–1302,1425–1465,1965–2021] |
| Prepared metadata counts `"0","0"`; separately omit either key or use `"-1"`, `"x"`, or Int64 overflow | Zero remains valid and classifies10; invalid metadata returns Nothing, leading to incomplete-cache handling, never light-band zero substitution. If the cache has been removed and no current failure memo blocks rebuilding, QueryViewport starts preparation and returns Preparing. Actual deletion/publication remain unverified. [S:2516–2568,2257–2259,519–540] |
| Validated geometry request: unprepared Automatic at9/10; stored manual14 at13/14 | At9/13 respectively, ZoomRequired before source resolution/preparation. At10/14 preparation may start; equality is eligibility, not guaranteed Ready. [S:498–540] |

Metadata also reports source counts100/2500 and effective minZoom10. Client pending policy is outside render range; known10 admits map zoom10. [P:92–105,382–393; S:2584–2593; C:199–247] |

Out-of-range12 stays visible but disabled; no-selection must not reset Automatic. Fractional, negative and18 selections fail. Background refresh preserves the draft and disables Save when invalid. [E:694–735,743–813,827–844] |
| Missing save key; authorization/type/feature-enable failure; otherwise changed valid options | Missing key rejects. Failed guards return before mutation. Persistence applies options, audits and submits; unchanged policy is a no-op; exceptions return Nothing. Exact override-parser/style-helper behavior remains uninspected. [A:343–400; K:306–346] |
| Save17 with Automatic14 already known; ACK descriptor has automaticZoom:null; separately return an ordinary failure while active, not disabled, and in the current save epoch | Saving blocks requests/policy updates and advances epoch. Successful ACK preserves known14, accepts override17 and closes editor after settlement. Only that ordinary failure restores prior policy and leaves attempted selection available for correction/retry; disabled refusals/concurrent disable follow the disabled branch. [C:259–276,405–408,1471–1568; E:853–872] |
| Old viewport arrives after bounds change/new policy; current response explicitly nulls Automatic | Bounds change aborts and advances generation; ordinary stale responses cannot apply. Current explicit null can restore pending and trigger eligible discovery; omitted Automatic preserves prior knowledge. [C:162–174,259–276,449–490,1088–1104] |
| A superseded response says disabled; HTTP identifiers/access invalid | Disabled is intentionally processed before stale-generation rejection: latch disabled, cancel work and clear features. HTTP invalid IDs produce400; failed project/visibility checks produce403. Do not assert every stale response is ignored. [C:449–457,489–520; H:197–225] |

Limits: exact request-parser/corrupt stored-style behavior (`TryParseOverride`, `ExtractOverride`, `ApplyOverride`) was not inspected, so no strict textual parser cases are asserted. Null-geometry exclusion is documented at P:73–75; its guard body was not returned. Complete scanner/GDAL internals, publication/retirement races and all response variants remain outside this bounded review. No application tests, browser, database/HTTP execution, configured deployment URL or compiled assets were verified. These observations accumulated across calls, not one atomic project snapshot.
